name: claudebridge
description: ClaudeBridge: optional native Claude model-menu controls, Codex authentication, dual agents, and project memory.
long_description: Integrate Claude and Codex from the original Claude Desktop interface. Keep the MCP extension, use optional Windows native model-picker controls through a local debugging pipe, and configure Off, On Demand, Fallback and Dual modes. Includes Codex CLI and persistent project memory.

tools.name: bridge_control_panel
tools.description: Open interactive mode and Codex account settings inside Claude.

tools.name: bridge_settings
tools.description: Persist Off, Manual, Fallback, Dual modes and working memory settings.

tools.name: bridge_native_picker
tools.description: Install, inspect or remove optional Windows native Claude model-menu controls without changing MCP.

tools.name: bridge_project
tools.description: Connect, list or switch local project folders.

tools.name: bridge_delegate
tools.description: Delegate parallel Codex coding or read-only reviews.

tools.name: bridge_plan
tools.description: Record original user prompts, proposed plans, approval, revisions and plan history.

tools.name: bridge_memory
tools.description: View timestamped local project changes and a compact handoff snapshot.

tools.name: bridge_context
tools.description: Read persisted agent messages and project history.
